g.title: j2764793069
g.text: What is that weird critter I see you running around with

g.title: j1202426103
g.text: You'd be surprised how little that narrows it down.

g.title: j1204106423
g.text: Ok it had big weird things coming off its head

g.title: j2520427600
g.text: Big weird things coming off its head

g.title: j2757851338
g.text: No clue. Might've been an Infested you saw chasing me.

g.title: j1199178431
g.text: Could be a vulpaphyla? Did it look like a "fox" or a skinny "dog" with big long ears with glowing things on them?

g.title: j2545278190
g.text: Could be a smeeta kavat? Did it look kind of like Kalymos but with big pointy ears?

g.title: j1024331167
g.text: Could be a vizier predasite? Did it look like a... big burly "dog" with glowing things on its head? Big bat ears?

g.title: j1927736906
g.text: Had glowing things on its ears

g.title: j1033830534
g.text: That's my sly vulpaphyla. They come from Deimos, the Infested planet. It's pretty rare you see one away from Deimos. :) They're harmless. Well. To you, anyway.

g.title: j976652916
g.text: That's my crescent vulpaphyla. They come from Deimos, the Infested planet. It's pretty rare you see one away from Deimos. :) They're harmless. Well. To you, anyway.

g.title: j3995666679
g.text: That's my panzer vulpaphyla. They come from Deimos, the Infested planet. :) They're harmless. Well. To you, anyway.

g.title: j2627233400
g.text: Just keep it away from me, ¿sí?

g.title: j757526040
g.text: But it's an adorable Infested animal, Lettie. You know you want to pet it.

g.title: j3780169535
g.text: I'm sure that's what they said about the Techrot

g.title: j3177207119
g.text: I hate it when you do that
